english.title: Cause without reasonable excuse on NHS premises a nuisance / disturbance - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) while on Welsh National Health Service premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), other than for the purpose of obtaining medical advice, treatment or care for yourself, caused, without reasonable excuse a nuisance or disturbance to an National Health Service staff member who was working there or was otherwise there in connection with work and refused without reasonable excuse to leave the premises when asked to do so by

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[a National Health Service staff member]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 119 of the Criminal Justice and Immigration Act 2008.
